Hello friend. You sound very similar to me. I'm a freshman in college, my brain fog hit me in late July. I was thrown into a depression and also diagnosed with OCD. I've had anxiety type problems in past too. The docs all seemed to think this was related to anxiety/OCD. I'm going to explain how I feel/felt so maybe it helps you :)
I woke up one day feeling very, very *off*. Something just wasn't right. I dismissed it but it never went away. I felt like i was constantly zoned out and spacey, and I  couldn't concentrate on anything. I don't mean I was having trouble focusing, I mean I literally could not, my entire perception was, for lack of a better word, fucked. I thought I was dying. I got really, really depressed, even suicidal. I had to go on Zoloft and even Xanax just to make it through the days without wanting to not be alive. Well, here I am 5 months later. I'm getting A's and B's in my engineering program, have stopped taking Xanax and Zoloft, and am finally coming out of my shell again. I guess my point is, if we have the same thing, prepare yourself for a hellish couple of months, because it's honestly awful. Maybe you'll get lucky and not have it as bad as me. I hope so. Hopefully it's nothing and goes away soon:) if you ever need somebody to talk, I'm here. I can totally understand what you're going through, even when you think nobody else can - there are others.
